svg.text: Architect 2.0
Soft and Pro share one project. A non-technical user can publish the preview. GitHub is optional.
1 SIGN IN
Account, then an httpOnly session
Logic: Register with a name, log in, or continue as a guest. The server hashes the password and sets a cookie. Later routes reject a missing session.
Tech: Next.js /api/auth, bcryptjs, jose HS256 JWT, cookie architect_session, Postgres users table (Neon).
2 PROMPT
Describe the job. Pick Soft or Pro.
Logic: One prompt creates one project. Soft stays on the outcome. Pro adds a framework. A new project spends 12 local credits. Attachments stay as knowledge text.
Tech: React studio, Zustand, projects row (mode, framework, prompt, connectors_json). Credits live in localStorage, not the database.
3 PLAN
Four questions, still no model call
Logic: Authority, evidence, memory, and audience become a markdown plan and a skill. The build later reads that plan. A blank canvas skips this and opens an empty flow named Untitled.
Tech: src/lib/plan.ts. Saved as answers_json, plan_json, and skill_md on the project.
4 FLOW AND AGENTS
The person draws the harness
Logic: Drag steps, connect the dots, Save or Enter keeps the edit. Agent cards work the same way. This graph is what Build is told to follow. It is not a running LangGraph process.
Tech: React canvases. workflow_json, agents_json, and edges_json in Postgres.
5 BUILD - server proxy
The browser never calls the model
Logic: The route checks the cookie and the owner, then adds the flow text to the prompt.
complete() asks for JSON: name, agents, files, preview HTML. If that call fails, a local template still builds the app. Untitled is renamed.
Tech: POST /api/projects/:id/generate. OpenAI gpt-4o-mini, JSON mode. Key stays in server env. Fallback: generateProjectFromPrompt().
6 PREVIEW AND CHAT
Sandbox, then an optional edit in plain language
Logic: Preview HTML sits in an iframe that cannot read the studio cookie. Chat goes through the same proxy and rewrites the page.
Tech: iframe sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-modals. POST /api/projects/:id/chat. preview_html, files_json, traces_json.
7 DEPLOY - Soft and Pro, no code required
Top bar Deploy. Ship the preview as a public link.
Logic: Choose an environment label and a region label, then Ship now. GitHub is not required.
The server copies preview HTML into published_apps. Anyone can open /a/slug. A second deploy updates that same row.
Tech: Deploy modal, POST /api/projects/:id/deploy, page /a/[slug], GET /api/a/[slug]. Same Vercel app. The region label is not a new data center.
8 PRO ONLY, OPTIONAL
Files and GitHub. Deploy stays the same button.
Logic: Pro can open Files, pick a Pro framework, connect GitHub, and push up to 20 files plus preview.html.
Import reads a repo back into the project. Soft never has to do this in order to publish.
Tech: GitHub OAuth (repo, read:user). Token AES-256-GCM from AUTH_SECRET. Git Data API. Export zip via jszip.
Live host: https://architect-2-kohl.vercel.app. Database: Neon Postgres, pool max 5. Secrets stay on the server.
Scale: one app and one database. More published previews are more rows, not more servers. Framework source is exported. It is not a second runtime.
